newsitem.title: INDIA: Buba official says sees no reason for weaker mark.
newsitem.headline: Buba official says sees no reason for weaker mark.

text.p: Bundesbank Vice President Johann Wilhelm Gaddum said on Monday he saw no reason for a weaker deutsche mark and the currency markets has not taken fully into account future expectations.
"There is no reason for a weaker deutche mark," Gaddum told Reuters in Bombay.
Gaddum said he understood why investors are currently drawn to the dollar by a U.S. economy showing good inflation and employment performances and a booming stockmarket.
"I can understand now that the dollar is a currency they like to invest (in)," Gaddum said.
"I would say that expectations for the deutsche mark are better than the market is seeing at the moment," he said.

"I would not say they (the foreign exchange markets) are looking at the wrong things but maybe they see, not completely, the right things," Gaddum said. He was speaking to Reuters following a speech to the Indo-German Chamber of Commerce.
